integrity: Exact side-weight inequalities give the lower bound, force side totals three and three at equality, and then force pairwise equality across every deleted matching pair.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats balanced crown graphs for n at least four.
The smaller crowns have additional weight-six minima.
Finite verification through n=5 is corroborative only.
A differently phrased or non-indexed crown result may exist.
title: Minimum double Italian functions of crown graphs
